import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,runpy
s=Path('src/IntervalFiniteGrid.lean').read_text()
pos=s.index('/-- A finite grid')
s=s[:pos]+'''theorem grid_bracket (grid : Nat → α) (h : Nat) (hh : 0 < h)
    (x : α) (lo : grid 0 ≤ x) (hi : x ≤ grid h) :
    ∃ q < h, grid q ≤ x ∧ x ≤ grid (q+1) := by
  induction h with
  | zero => omega
  | succ h ih =>
    by_cases hz : h = 0
    · subst h
      exact ⟨0, by omega, lo, hi⟩
    · by_cases hx : x ≤ grid h
      · obtain ⟨q,hq,hlo,hhi⟩ := ih (by omega) hx
        exact ⟨q,by omega,hlo,hhi⟩
      · exact ⟨h, by omega, le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hx), hi⟩

'''+s[pos:]
a=s.index('    (cover :'); b=s.index('    ∀ x,',a)
s=s[:a]+'    (hh : 0 < h) :\n'+s[b:]
s=s.replace('(cover x hx hy)','(grid_bracket grid h hh x hx hy)').replace('#print axioms finite_grid_envelope','#print axioms grid_bracket\n#print axioms finite_grid_envelope')
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'src/IntervalFiniteGrid.lean'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
os.environ.update(FORMAL_OPERATION='compile',FORMAL_MODULE='IntervalFiniteGrid');runpy.run_path(str(Path.cwd()/'stack_driver.py'),run_name='__main__')
